description: Piano Protezione Civile - Aree di emergenza is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sit.comune.certaldo.fi.it. Localisation of emergency areas as per Civil Protection Plan. The current civil protection plan was approved on 21/03/2017 with Resolution No 1 of the Council of the Union of Municipalities of the Empolese Valdelsa. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Civil Protection Plan — Emergency Areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include open data, protezione civile, emergenza. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
